title: Salamanda Machine-Readable Diagnostics
description: Structured validation and build error diagnostics designed for both AI self-correction loops (Amphibian) and human CLI output.

valid.description: True if no error-severity diagnostics were produced.

code.description: Stable diagnostic error code (e.g., SAL-PERM-001, SAL-SLOT-002, SAL-EDIT-003).

path.description: TOML key path or file path where the issue occurred (e.g., 'permissions.egress[0]' or 'ui[0].slot').

message.description: Clear human- and LLM-readable description of the violation.

hint.description: Explanation of why the policy or contract check failed.

suggested_fix.description: Concrete replacement snippet or actionable instruction for an AI authoring client.
